prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from tray and move it to capping device to screw on the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: capping device
What the inspection checks: Check near capping device whether the test tube on the gripper has been screwed on.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A benchtop instrument stands on a light grey perforated optical-style table. At left is a white column with a black vertical rail and a white head unit bearing a yellow warning label and screws; a black cable runs from its top right. Below the head, a red-capped tube or nozzle assembly is held in a black bracket, angled downward; its red portion sits above a red-orange body, with no visible liquid inside.

To the right, black anodised linear stages and a green mounting plate support a white-and-silver robotic arm joint that extends from the right edge toward the stage. A thin white cable loops over the green plate. Behind, at upper right, is a white instrument with a red digital display and blue labelled panel.
observations: The description mentions a red-capped assembly in a bracket and a robotic arm joint, but it does not confirm the presence of a test tube on the gripper or its capping status.
